title: Core Term When an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Is Revised
content:
**Decision table.** When the installment of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement in force is re-figured, its remaining term is built on a core term set by the arrangement's record.

**Definitions.**

- An arrangement runs to the class's longest arrangement in installments (12 in every class except Commercial HMO and Commercial PPO, where it is 18) from its start date.
- The installments fallen due are the whole calendar months from the arrangement's start date to the handling date, plus one.
- The installments still to fall due are the longest arrangement less the installments fallen due.

**Core term.**

| Patient-payment entries posted fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the handling date | Installments still to fall due | Core term |
|---|---|---|
| at least 3 | at least 3 | the installments still to fall due — the original end date is kept |
| at least 3 | fewer than 3 | re-anchored on the benefit year: the months left in the current benefit year, 12 less the whole calendar months between the coverage record's benefit-year start and the handling date |
| fewer than 3 | any | the class's longest arrangement, counted afresh |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; Commercial HMO, longest arrangement 18)

1. Start date 8 whole months before the handling date: 9 installments fallen due, 9 still to fall due. 4 payment entries in the last 3 whole months: core term **9**.
2. Start date 15 whole months before: 16 fallen due, 2 still to fall due. 3 payment entries in the window; benefit-year start 5 whole months before the handling date: core term 12 less 5, **7**.
3. Start date 8 whole months before, only 2 payment entries in the window: core term **18**.
